text:
amanda_cs: Kicking off the Lynx field trial now — enrolling 6 seats. Need an enablement playbook, OIDC/Okta quickstart, telemetry plan, and a lightweight weekly feedback loop. Who can pick up the playbook + survey? :wave:
julian_csm: I talked to Lynx PM earlier. They want a low-latency demo and are nervous about SSO and seat limits — flagging medium renewal risk if onboarding drags. Will do outreach after enablement is scheduled. :eyes:
sam_ops: Added to the master tracker and calendar: https://go.redwood/internal/field-trials/lynx — invited Lynx contacts and our team. I can own scheduling and invite cadence. noted seat assignments. :calendar:
rebecca_pm: I can draft a 1-minute survey + enablement runbook. Draft survey below — open to edits:
```json
{"q1":"How often did you use the new connector? (daily/weekly/never)","q2":"Rate latency from 1-5","q3":"What broke / what would you like next?"}
```
Also propose a short kickoff agenda: 20m quick demo, 15m Okta walk-through, 10m telemetry & success metrics, 15m Q&A.
tom_engineer: Can deliver an OIDC quickstart guide + minimal test app by Friday (2 business days). Need: Okta admin contact and example metadata (issuer, client_id). If they need SAML later that's a bigger lift.
amanda_cs: Lynx confirmed they use Okta and will provide metadata tomorrow morning. Good plan on the kickoff agenda.
julian_csm: Re: renewal risk — add action: capture early usage signals (DAU for the connector, avg latency) and a weekly scorecard. If week 2 adoption < 30% of expected, we'll escalate to a 1:1 exec touch.
sam_ops: I'll wire up a shared dashboard tile for DAU + avg latency and hook alerts to the CS playbook. Will also set a weekly recurring 30m feedback sync (opt: Wed 10am PT or Thu 9am PT) — preference?
rebecca_pm: Wed 10am PT works for me. I'll publish the survey (in-app and email) and auto-email results to the channel.
tom_engineer: Quickstart snippet (for the runbook) — put this in the repo and link in runbook:
```bash
# exchange metadata
curl -X POST https://lynx.example.com/api/sso/metadata -d '{"issuer":"https://org.okta.com","client_id":"REDACTED"}'
```
I can mock sample metadata for the kickoff if Lynx isn't ready.
deploybot: Created task CS-4317 (Lynx field trial onboarding) and assigned to sam_ops, rebecca_pm, tom_engineer. https://tasks.redwood/CS-4317
amanda_cs: Quick ownership roundup — Rebecca: survey + runbook; Tom: OIDC quickstart + demo app; Sam: tracker + scheduling + dashboard tile; Julian: renewal watch & exec escalation plan. I'll run the kickoff tomorrow at 10am PT and capture meeting notes in the tracker. Please drop any blockers here before EOD. :thumbsup:
